identification: Large decorative Australian bush droving scene, oil on board, gilt frame with orange slip. Drover on grey horse leading brown horses through dappled sunlit gum trees. Signature in yellow lower left reads Wapener (or Wepener/Wagener); no artist of that name found. Looks like mid to late 20th century decorative output, not a recorded name.
